title: The person's own mark on a conversation's place in Sinun vuorosi
description: Root: the reply of POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/turn. The person's daemon keeps one mark per conversation so that every device shows the same: raised (Nosta) brings a quiet conversation to Sinun vuorosi, not_now (Ei nyt) sends it to Hiljaiset until the agent replies again. The daemon removes the mark when Pi accepts the person's next message and when the conversation is archived.

mark.description: raised: the person raised the conversation at `at`; it waits in Sinun vuorosi until they reply, choose Ei nyt, or the agent replies after `at`. not_now: the person chose Ei nyt at `at` for the reply `reply_id` (absent when the conversation had none); a later reply with another ID brings the conversation back.

request.description: The body of POST /api/v1/conversations/<id>/turn. reply_id names the conversation's last reply the person said Ei nyt to; only with not_now.
